newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade hefty at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade hefty at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and
heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting good buyer inquiry.
WK to date - 67,400 Last week - 53,100 Year Ago - 31,300

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1175 lbs 62.50. Select and Choice 1-3 1200-1250 lb Holsteins 56.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.

Sales reported on 26,000 slaughter steers and 10,500 heifers; 67,400 head confirmed for week to date which includes 30,500 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
